title: ClockTimeDisplay
description: Hold a clock to see in-game time.
body:
# ⏰ ClockTimeDisplay — Elegant In-Game Time Display for Your Server!
ClockTimeDisplay is a lightweight and stylish plugin for Paper 1.21.1+ servers that shows the current in-game time directly in the action bar when a player holds a clock. Perfect for survival servers, roleplay, or any server where players need to track the day/night cycle!

# ✨ Features
Simple & Intuitive — just hold a clock in your main or off-hand, and the time appears!

Real-Time Updates — time refreshes every second, always accurate.

Clean Action Bar Display — beautiful gold-colored text with a clock emoji.

Auto-Hide — time display disappears instantly when you switch away from the clock.

12-Hour Format — displays time in AM/PM format (e.g., ⏰ 03:24 PM).

Zero Configuration — plug-and-play, no setup required!

# 🎮 How It Works
Holds the clock in either main hand or off-hand.

Action bar instantly shows the current Minecraft game time.

Switch to another item — the display disappears.

Switch back to the clock — time reappears!

# 🕒 Time Format
The plugin converts Minecraft ticks to real-world time:

Game Time	Display
Sunrise (6:00)	⏰ 06:00 AM
Noon (12:00)	⏰ 12:00 PM
Sunset (18:00)	⏰ 06:00 PM
Midnight (0:00)	⏰ 12:00 AM
Format: ⏰ HH:MM AM/PM

# 📦 Installation
Download ClockTimeDisplay-1.0.jar.

Place it in your server's plugins folder.

Restart your server (or run reload).

Done! Players can now see time by holding a clock.


# ❓ FAQ

### Does it work with off-hand clocks?
Yes! Clocks in either main hand or off-hand will display the time.

### What if a player has a clock in both hands?
No problem — the plugin detects it and shows the time once.

### Does this affect performance?
The plugin is extremely lightweight. It only runs a check every second and only processes players holding clocks.
